descriptionChirho: Service performed in connection with the tabernacle, temple, or sanctuary worship, often in construct with a following genitive specifying the sacred object or place (Arabic خِدْمَة, Swahili utumishi/huduma, Korean 봉사/섬김).
Non-cultic service rendered to a person, king, or community, including assigned duties and ministerial roles (Arabic خِدْمَة in non-sacred contexts, Swahili huduma/utumishi, Korean 봉사/섬김).
Physical work, manual toil, or agricultural labor as productive human activity (Arabic عَمَل, Swahili kazi, Korean 일/노동/수고).
Forced labor, slavery, or oppressive servitude imposed upon a subjugated people (Arabic عُبُودِيَّة/اسْتِعْبَاد, Swahili utumwa, Korean 노역/종살이).
